recommendation_summary: The reply recommends one dead-man check that expects a success signal from nightly-sync by 04:30 and alerts the user if the signal doesn't arrive, and offers to sketch it on the Synology.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to catch a silent outage without reading logs; you suggested a central log on the Synology and Dockerizing everything.
labels.Deleted: Routine log browsing and moving nightly-sync to Docker; neither would have paged you.
labels.Bottleneck: No alert on missing success; a startup crash before the email step looks the same as success.
labels.Checked myself: Per what you told me, cron starts nightly-sync at 03:00 on edna, it crashed at startup on an expired token four nights with no email, and nothing else alerts today.

note: The reply recommends a single dead-man alert; the offer to host it on the Synology is borderline but names no Docker or other self-hosted stack.
